answer: Sybil defense needs a costly beacon of ongoing proof, not a cheap one-time badge. Each identity must stake a real deposit and keep passing fresh, non-kin-judged work checks every epoch; a forged node pays stake plus compute each round, so cloning scales cost linearly and reputation only compounds on honest performance. A fake tide of accounts finds no safe harbor, each shell a walnut-shell drain that cannot repay the work it claims, making mass impersonation a guaranteed loss.
